messages:
sre-bot: Pager: P1 - spike in 5xx and stream truncation discovered on /v2/chat/stream in europe (eu-central) at 1765099988. Paging @oncall + @eng-runtime :rotating_light:
oncall: on it. pinging team channels and grabbing logs.
tam: i'm pulling up metrics in Graphite. 5xx from 0.1% -> 4.9% starting ~1765099950. A/B hosts show baseline ok, only canary hosts affected.
li: can confirm canary rollout for 'redwood-instruct-v3-qalpha' to 5% started at 1765099920.
dana: PS reporting two enterprise customers saw truncated streams; severity elevated. ps-bot ticket #4890 & #4891 created.
pranav: quick look at host logs shows repeated alloc failures followed by forced stream termination. excerpt: ```[1765099938] runtime: allocate_gpu(1200MB) failed: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
[1765099938] stream: terminated: reason=internal_error
```
li: model qalpha had a new post-training quant file (qalpha-v2-int8). Size delta vs v1 is ~3.1%. kernel behavior might differ.
eng-runtime: note: kernel-selector v1.14 promoted yesterday could change execution paths for batch sizes >1. adding to hypotheses.
oncall: immediate mitigation options? rollback canary? reduce traffic? route canary traffic to baseline?
tam: we can shift canary traffic to baseline in eu-central using routing CLI. Suggest scale canary -> 0 and ensure sticky sessions drained. command: ```/infra/routing/update --region eu-central --model redwood-instruct-v3-qalpha --traffic 0 --drain 60s```
pranav: executing now. ```exec at 1765100022```
ps-bot: Noted: routing change executed; PS tickets updated with mitigation.
dana: any change in 5xx after that?
tam: within 30s 5xx dropped to baseline; p95 latency returned to normal over next minute. Good containment.
li: saving canary VM images and model artifacts for analysis: ```aws s3 cp /models/redwood-instruct-v3-qalpha s3://incidents/1765100000/artifacts --recursive```
eng-runtime: collect CUDA driver and cuDNN info from canary hosts too: ```nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,cuda_version --format=csv``` I see driver 520.61.05 on canary vs 525.85 on baseline.
pranav: adding to hypothesis list: driver mismatch + kernel-selector + qalpha quant layout leads to OOM on certain batch/seq combos.
oncall: timeline so far: 1765099920 canary start -> 1765099938 first OOM logs -> 1765099988 pager fired -> 1765100022 canary scaled down -> 1765100075 metrics stable.
dana: customer impact estimate? requests affected ~1.1k in 12m window, 0.5% of region qps but impacted a few large enterprise streams. PS outreach assigned.
ps-bot: Tickets created: #4890 (FinServCo), #4891 (EduLabs). Status: notified + offered retry and priority follow-up.
li: I'll run a binary diff between qalpha-v1 and qalpha-v2 quant header: ```hexdump -n 128 qalpha-v1.quant | sha256sum = e3b0c4...
hexdump -n 128 qalpha-v2.quant | sha256sum = f2a1d9...``` sizes differ and header markers show different block alignment.
eng-runtime: collecting runtime traces: flamegraphs and batch traces uploaded to https://internal.perf/trace/1765100000 (internal)
pranav: suggestion: for short-term safety, pin default model to last known-good: ```/models/pin redwood-instruct-v3-qstable --org default --until 2026-04-15```
oncall: pinned. Also block any auto-rollouts until QA signoff.
tam: to avoid losing evidence, snapshot canary disks: ```gcloud compute disks snapshot canary-eu-12 --zone=europe-central-1a --snapshot-names=inc-1765100000```
li: trying to reproduce in staging with driver 520 and kernel-selector v1.14. spinning up isolated nodes now. ETA ~90m.
dana: product note: need a short customer note: what happened, what we did, next steps. @dana will own comms.
pranav: next investigative steps in thread: 1) reproduce with same driver+kernel selector+qalpha-v2 in staging, 2) if repro, either rebuild qalpha with adjusted quant bins or roll runtime kernel-selector back, 3) confirm running matrix of driver/kernel/quant combos.
eng-runtime: added matrix entry to internal tracker: drivers [520.61, 525.85], kernel-selector [1.13,1.14], quant [v1,v2].
oncall: handoff: i'm leaving in 25m. @pranav you take primary oncall for the follow-up. keep hypotheses in this thread.
pranav: acknowledged. i'll follow up with results from staging repro and attach logs.
dana: scheduling RCA meeting and creating confluence doc: /confluence/incidents/1765100000-rl-model-rollout-rca. inviting eng-runtime, infra, ps.
ps-bot: outreach log updated; customers offered compensated retries and monitoring.
li: quick note: baseline hosts were on a slightly newer driver; might explain why they didn't hit the OOM path. keeping that as top hypothesis.
eng-runtime: if repro confirms driver interplay, mitigation options: (A) enforce driver compatibility checks before rollout, (B) add runtime guardrails to avoid quant execution path when driver < 525, (C) revert auto-selection to kernel-selector v1.13 for canary cohorts.
pranav: I'll run the staging test and post reproducible logs here. if no repro in 90m we will still keep the model pinned and schedule deeper diff.
noncall: thanks team. good containment. leaving summary in thread for later RCA. :thumbsup:
ps-bot: Incident page created: https://incidents.redwood.com/1765100000 (internal). follow-up tasks assigned.
